method: deterministic pseudorandom seed Monte Carlo; official current game engines with recovery credit fix; hypothetical policies, not measured users
loans: initial 1000 principal +3% fee; extra 1000 if needed and possible; shift 300 wage +1% principal interest when no further full loan lot possible; every 50 actions +1% principal interest capped at 50% lifetime borrowed
repayPolicy: when equity>max(200, 3x current stake), repay 25% of wallet above reserve, up to outstanding debt; strategy fixed before outcomes
limitations: The simulation studies only these policies and a deterministic PRNG; it does not measure real-player behavior.
No guarantee of profit even when a conditional bet has positive EV; debt rates and interest costs remain separate.
RTP under adaptive strategies is policy-conditioned; it is not the all-outcomes unconditional house RTP.
Wealth quantiles are outcomes of these sampled paths, not exact probabilities.
Not a representative user sample; exact probabilities depend on chosen strategies and PRNG.
The lender is a fictional debt ledger; cash deposits, real interest and money are absent.
The high-stake scenario can still experience large short-term gains and losses; a positive ending is not guaranteed.
Different stake settings are not head-to-head controls.

description: Dealer v81 posterior-sensitive quote balance; 750 seeded scenarios x 500 paid actions per policy; different stake policies not directly comparable; model results not real-player success probabilities.
